blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — US President Donald Trump will attend the 49th Asean Summit in Manila in November, Palace press officer Claire Castro confirmed on Wednesday. “It is confirmed, pero ‘yung details siguro hindi po sa akin manggagaling (but the details won’t be coming from me),” Castro said in a briefing. Details of Trump’s visit, however, have yet to be disclosed. The White House had earlier confirmed Trump’s attendance at the regional bloc’s summit.
